jobs.title: Senior People Operations Manager (f/m/d)
jobs.description: bunch is building the backbone of private markets. We are enabling next-gen fund operations with one integrated system that combines secure data infrastructure, AI-powered workflows and expert fund services. If you value ownership, growth through real responsibility, and working with a thoughtful, ambitious team, this role might be for you. Your Role bunch is around 155 people across Berlin, London, and Amsterdam, and Luxembourg, on the way to roughly 200 in 2027. That means four legal entities, four payroll providers, different sets of people systems to reconcile, different compliance environments. Right now our People operations run 50% on effort. We want them to run mostly on systems. We also want our people data to be trustworthy enough that headcount, attrition, and hiring numbers are the same in every room they're quoted in. This person will own the operational and data backbone that the rest of the People function depends on. Your role Take full, end-to-end ownership of core People Operations topics — including onboarding, offboarding, contracts, leaves, absence, payroll, immigration cases and documentation — from decision-making through execution. Design, build, and roll out automated, AI-supported workflows and integrations across our tools — including Personio (HRIS) and Notion — to eliminate manual work and connect our systems. Coordinate monthly payroll across Germany, the UK and the Netherlands and in the near future, Luxembourg, with our external providers. You own data accuracy, deadlines and the provider relationships — the providers own the processing. Maintain the compliance calendar and the documentation behind it, working with external counsel where local employment law is involved. Manage and support our full workforce across multiple contract types and locations, ensuring correct setup, documentation, and ongoing administration for each. Be the first line for employee questions on policy, contracts, leave and benefits — and steadily reduce that

jobs.title: People Operations Partner
jobs.description: Playson is looking for a People Operations Partner who can bring operational clarity into a fast-moving environment and help scale People Operations through strong execution, process thinking, coordination, and automation. This role sits closer to operational systems coordination than traditional HR administration. We are looking for someone who naturally thinks in: workflows, dependencies, automations, ownership, bottlenecks, scalability, and operational efficiency. You will work closely with PBPs, business leaders, Finance, Legal, Service Desk, and employees across the company to ensure people-related processes work reliably, clearly, and without unnecessary friction. You will also work across multiple operational systems and platforms used within the People function, including HRIS, ATS, learning, benefits, and engagement tools. What you’ll bring Knowledge of the Ukrainian language is a must 3+ years in operational coordination/people operations/business operations / process-heavy environments Strong operational coordination and process management skills. High attention to detail and execution quality. Ability to manage multiple workflows in a fast-paced environment. Strong ownership mindset and proactive follow-up habits. Systems and process-thinking mindset. Interest in automation, AI tooling, operational scalability, and process optimisation. Ability to simplify operations without losing accuracy or control. Comfortable working in environments where processes are still evolving and being built. Experience working with operational platforms and systems (HRIS / ATS / LMS / benefits platforms etc., HiBob experience is a strong plus). Strong communication and stakeholder coordination skills. Upper-Intermediate English or higher. What you’ll do Coordinate onboarding, offboarding, internal moves, compensation changes, probation workflows, and other employee lifecycle processes. Maintain operational consistency and data accuracy across People systems and platforms. C

jobs.title: Talent Acquisition Partner
jobs.description: CAIS is the pioneer in democratizing access to and education about alternative investments for independent financial advisors, empowering them to engage and transact with leading asset managers on a massive scale through a wide variety of alternative investment products and technology solutions. CAIS provides financial advisors with a broad selection of alternative investment strategies, including hedge funds, private equity, private credit, real estate, digital assets, and structured notes. CAIS also delivers industry-leading technology, operational efficiency, and world-class client service throughout the pre-trade, trade, and post-trade experience. CAIS serves over 2,500 wealth management firms that support more than 65,000 financial advisors who oversee approximately $8.5 trillion in end-client assets. About the Role   CAIS is seeking a Talent Acquisition Partner to lead technology hiring from initial brief through accepted offer, focusing on quality, consistency, and speed of hiring. This is an individual contributor role for an accomplished technical recruiter who combines exceptional sourcing and market-mapping capability with sound judgement, commercial understanding, and credibility with senior technology leaders. You will recruit across Engineering, Product, Machine Learning, Data, Corporate Technology, and Security, and flex into other areas of the business as priorities shift. The role is based in London, with hiring across our teams in the United Kingdom and United States.   We are particularly interested in recruiters who have successfully managed a broad portfolio of technical searches at the same time, rather than specializing exclusively in one discipline. Experience in one or more of the functions above is valuable. Candidates from any technology environment are welcome, and those with financial services or fintech experience are likely to bring relevant market understanding. Experience across every discipline or sector is not expected. &

jobs.title: Head of HR
jobs.description: WHO ARE WE? Launch Potato is the discovery and conversion company. We reach tens of millions of people every month through our brands, including FinanceBuzz , All About Cookies , and OnlyInYourState . We turn that attention into real outcomes for our partners, some of the world's leading companies. Our mission: create predictable, high-value customer acquisition at scale by connecting discovery, intent, and performance across category-leading consumer brands in finance, travel, and entertainment. We run profitable and bootstrapped, with a South Florida HQ and a remote-first team across 18 countries. WHY JOIN US? You own outcomes here, not tasks. We measure work by impact, not activity. The pace is real, and change is constant, so the people who do best turn change into opportunity instead of waiting for it to settle. Feedback runs direct and lands with respect. Ordinary people make themselves extraordinary at Launch Potato . Base salary: $170,000 to $190,000. Plus an annual bonus paid as a flat amount rather than a percentage of base. Launch Potato is about 200 people, profitable, and growing. The performance management system that got us here was built by our SVP of Talent, and he still runs it. That system becomes yours. You're inheriting something that works. There's a levels framework, a rating scale, a calibration process, and managers who have been through several cycles. It got us to 200 people. Your job is deciding what carries forward and change-managing the rest, across an org that moves fast and adopts new processes. We want someone who'll find the version that works and then hold it there while the company gets good at it. In deze vacature als HR Business Partner bij Koninklijke Van Wijhe Verf in Zwolle krijg je veel ruimte om HR verder te professionaliseren en zelfstandig projecten te realiseren. Een fulltime of parttime baan bij een duurzame, innovatieve werkgever waar jouw advies zichtbaar impact heeft. Taken Maak het verschil als HR Business Partner in Zwolle Dankzij jouw brede HR-expertise krijgen leidinggevenden een stevige sparringpartner en ontwikkelt HR mee met de ambities van de organisatie. Als HR Business Partner adviseer je zelfstandig jouw klantgroepen over strategische, tactische én operationele HR-vraagstukken. Je beweegt gemakkelijk tussen organisatieontwikkeling, verandertrajecten en concrete personeelscasuïstiek. Daarbij kijk je kritisch naar bestaande processen en vertaal je ideeën naar concrete verbeteringen. Je werkt nauw samen met de HR Manager en andere HR-collega’s en hebt veel contact met leidinggevenden binnen onder meer Koninklijke Van Wijhe Verf en Mooij Verf. Ook zet je HR en financiële data gericht in om keuzes te onderbouwen en pak je zelfstandig projecten op rondom thema’s als Strategische personeelsinzet, medewerker ontwikkeling, duurzame inzetbaarheid en organisatie- en teamontwikkeling. Kortom, jij pakt de regie bij het: adviseren en ondersteunen van leidinggevenden bij strategische, tactische en operationele HR-vraagstukken; begeleiden van organisatieontwikkeling en verandertrajecten; zelfstandig initiëren en realiseren van HR-projecten rondom onder andere strategische HR, ontwikkeling en duurzame inzetbaarheid; analyseren van HR-data en vertalen van inzichten naar concrete adviezen en verbeteringen; professionaliseren van HR-processen en versterken van de brede inzetbaarheid binnen het HR-team. Als HR adviseur Onderwijs bij Lyceo krijg je de ruimte om inhoudelijk impact te maken én een bredere rol binnen het team te pakken. Je ondersteunt leidinggevenden, begeleidt verzuimtrajecten, verbetert HR processen en coördineert de werkzaamheden binnen het team HR en Salaris. Een veelzijdige volgende stap voor een ervaren HR professional die inhoudelijk sterk is en al ervaring heeft met het begeleiden, coördineren of aansturen van collega's. Je blijft nadrukkelijk zelf actief in de dagelijkse HR praktijk. De ene dag begeleid je een leidinggevende bij een complex verzuimdossier, de andere dag stem je prioriteiten binnen het team af, bespreek je de voortgang van recruitment of werk je aan nieuw HR beleid. Zo verbind je HR beleid, processen en de dagelijkse praktijk met elkaar. jobs.description: Den Haag Ben jij een daadkrachtige, nauwkeurige en zelfstandige HR-medewerker die graag zorgt dat zaken goed geregeld zijn? Vind je het leuk om vragen uit te zoeken, actie te ondernemen en ervoor te zorgen dat HR-zaken daadwerkelijk worden afgehandeld? Voor Praktijk Rood zijn wij op zoek naar een HR-officer. Een fijne collega die ziet wat er moet gebeuren, dit zelfstandig oppakt en zorgt dat zaken niet blijven liggen. Over Praktijk Rood Praktijk Rood is een groeiende organisatie voor psychologische zorg aan kinderen, jongeren en jongvolwassenen. Vanuit verschillende locaties werken betrokken professionals samen om goede en toegankelijke zorg te bieden. Als HR-medewerker zorg jij ervoor dat de HR-administratie goed is geregeld en dat de teammanagers en medewerkers met hun vragen bij jou terechtkunnen. Je bent praktisch ingesteld, houdt overzicht en vindt het prettig om zaken van het begin tot het einde op te pakken. Taken In deze functie ben je verantwoordelijk voor de dagelijkse uitvoering van verschillende HR-werkzaamheden. Je krijgt veel ruimte om zelfstandig te werken en neemt actief zaken op je. Je werkzaamheden bestaan onder andere uit: Opstellen en verwerken van arbeidsovereenkomsten, contractwijzigingen en andere personeelsdocumenten. Verzorgen van de administratieve afhandeling rondom indiensttreding, wijzigingen en uitdiensttreding. Verzorgen van de verlofadministratie. Bijhouden, controleren en compleet houden van personeelsdossiers. Actief oppakken van binnenkomende vragen en verzoeken uit de HR-mailbox. Beantwoorden van vragen van medewerkers over bijvoorbeeld contracten, verlof, arbeidsvoorwaarden en andere personeelszaken. Zelf uitzoeken van vragen wanneer je het antwoord niet direct weet en ervoor zorgen dat de medewerker tijdig wordt geholpen. Opstellen en bijhouden van HR-mutatieoverzichten en ervoor zorgen dat wijzigingen volledig en correct worden aangeleverd bij de externe salarisadministratie. Comment on fait ? On ne peut pas révolutionner le monde en travaillant comme tout le monde On essaye de ne pas trop se prendre la tête, ici on évolue dans un environnement sans trop de process ni trop de règles. Le plus important, ce n’est pas seulement de suivre le mouvement, mais de le créer. On ne veut pas créer des clones d’entreprise. On te veut toi, avec tes talents, tes perspectives et tes compétences uniques. Tu as envie de rejoindre une entreprise qui grandit vite, avec beaucoup d’autonomie et une façon assez différente de faire les People Ops ? Bienvenue chez Octopus Energy France. Chez nous, nous fonctionnons selon un modèle NoHR : les managers sont le premier point de contact people de leurs équipes. Le rôle de l’équipe People Ops est de leur donner le bon cadre, les bons outils, les bonnes informations et les bons réflexes pour qu’ils puissent être autonomes au quotidien. Dans ce contexte, nous cherchons aujourd’hui quelqu’un de solide en People Ops , capable à la fois de construire et faire évoluer nos façons de travailler , mais aussi de contribuer concrètement au quotidien de l’équipe . Le poste est organisé autour de deux grands volets, qui représentent chacun environ 50 % du rôle : du build : projets People, outils, data, automatisation, IA, amélioration de nos process du run : administration du personnel, paie, support aux managers et aux équipes, contrôle et fiabilisation des données Cet équilibre n’est évidemment pas figé : selon les actualités, les projets ou les périodes de l’année, tu pourras passer davantage de temps sur l’un ou l’autre. jobs.description: Job Title: People Operations Coordinator - Temp to FTE Opportunity, 3 month contract Job Location: United States, Remote This is a fully remote opportunity and can be worked from any location in the United States. ABOUT THE COMPANY: Salesloft is building the next era of enterprise revenue — one where teams make confident decisions powered by AI and real signals. By combining our scale, insights, and AI innovation, we're building the industry's first Predictive Revenue System, enabling humans and AI to work together to make smarter decisions and drive consistent growth. With thousands of customers using our platforms every day, we have an unmatched view into how revenue is actually won — the Revenue Context that reveals what happens, when, and with what outcome. This gives us a unique opportunity to transform an entire category and set a new benchmark for how modern revenue teams operate. Join us to help transform how companies around the world run revenue — and build the platform that will guide leading revenue teams into the future. THE OPPORTUNITY: At Salesloft, our People Operations Coordinator is foundational to a high-performing People team. Each coordinator embeds with their assigned business function(s) (e.g., Engineering, Marketing, Sales) to provide full employee lifecycle support, from offer through exit. As the first point of contact for employees and managers, coordinators deliver high-volume, high-accuracy service across HR transactions, data, leave, employee relations support, and employee questions, creating a consistently excellent employee experience. They partner closely with People Business Partners, keeping the work moving, the data clean, and the PBP fully informed, and work alongside Total Rewards, Benefits and Mobility, and Talent Acquisition so programs run smoothly. jobs.title: (Senior) Talent Acquisition Partner - Tech (f/m/d)
jobs.description: At Moss, we give finance professionals the power to automate their day-to-day and make forward-thinking decisions. Our culture is what makes that possible: we play to win, we obsess over quality, and we win as One Moss, and it works. Moss closed a €35 million Series C in August 2026, crossing a €1 billion valuation, and became one of Europe's fintech unicorns. Join us for what's next. Our Talent Acquisition team is searching for a (Senior) Talent Acquisition Partner. You will play a pivotal role in helping Moss attract and hire the right talent for our tech positions, especially across Engineering. Reporting to the TA Director, you will join a team of five Talent Acquisition Partners across Berlin and London, covering every market and every role up to C-suite. Your responsibilities Sourcing, screening & managing candidates - identify, attract and engage with talent by using different sourcing techniques and channels. Manage the entire candidate journey from initial contact, coordinating interviews to offer management, ensuring a high quality candidate experience. Business Partnering - Own full-cycle hiring for your vertical end to end, from sourcing through offer, across all locations. Work directly with the leadership and hiring managers on all their hiring needs. Develop deep understanding of the businesses you support to help them make better hiring decisions, not just fill vacancies. Process improvement - Identify opportunities to reduce friction points across the interview process and the candidate journey, and implement experiments and improvements. Share sourcing techniques and hiring intelligence with the wider TA team across verticals and markets. AI & Tooling - Contribute to making us more efficient and faster by leveraging existing AI workflows and helping us build new ones (Claude, chatGPT, n8n). jobs.title: Contracts Manager Federal
jobs.description:
$100,000 - $120,000 a year Akicita Federal, LLC is a growing 8(a) small business that delivers healthcare, professional, and administrative services to federal agencies. We're adding a contracts manager to help us grow beyond our current work. The job is to find opportunities, write winning proposals quickly, and build lasting relationships with agencies and teaming partners. What you'll do Find and respond to federal opportunities, focusing on small business and 8(a) set-asides Write, assemble, and submit proposals at high volume, often turning one around in a day or two Manage contracts after award: point of contact for agencies, modifications, compliance, and reporting Spend about a quarter of your time on teaming and partnership outreach to other small businesses Work with our recruiting team to staff new awards Use AI tools to work faster. We expect speed and don't want proposals built by hand from scratch. What you bring 3+ years in federal contracting: contracts management, proposal writing, capture, or program management Solid understanding of the FAR, set-aside programs, and the federal procurement process An existing network of agency or contractor relationships is a strong plus You're comfortable with AI tools, or eager to become a power user You'd rather submit ten good proposals than polish one forever

jobs.title: Human Resources Intern
jobs.description: The Organization & Employee Development Intern will support the HR team in employee engagement activities, training and development, and organization development. The role involves assisting with planning, coordination, documentation, and program support while gaining practical experience in HR operations and communication. Core Responsibilities: Documentation & Logistics Support: Assist in preparing HR program materials, coordinating event logistics, maintaining accurate records, organizing files, and communicating schedules and requirements to participants. Program Implementation Support: Support the execution of employee engagement and development activities by facilitating sessions, assisting speakers, monitoring program delivery, collecting feedback, and ensuring smooth event operations. Event Proposal Development: Help conceptualize and prepare employee engagement event proposals, conduct research, collaborate with stakeholders, create multimedia materials for internal communications, and develop a comprehensive event proposal from planning through execution.
